name: HLBANK
recent: Hong Leong Bank 近期公告以 EPF 的股东权益变动申报为主，并于 10 月 26 日召开第 85 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过。同期公司宣布与 Alipay+ 及 UnionPay International 扩大跨境 QR 支付合作，其 RM1 亿高级票据也已到期。
notable: 第 85 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 10 月 26 日举行，所有决议以投票方式通过。
公司与 Alipay+ 及 UnionPay International 合作扩大跨境 QR 支付连接。
公司 RM1 亿高级票据到期。
risks: EPF 在 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报股东权益变动。
董事会及提名与薪酬委员会出现人事变动，包括 Alan Hamzah Sendut 的职务变动。

recent_en: Hong Leong Bank's recent announcements were mainly EPF's substantial shareholder changes, and it held its 85th AGM on 26 October 2026 where all resolutions were passed. Meanwhile, the bank expanded cross-border QR payment partnerships with Alipay+ and UnionPay International, and its RM100 million senior notes matured.
notable_en: The 85th AGM was held on 26 October 2026 and all resolutions were passed by poll.
The bank expanded cross-border QR payment connectivity through partnerships with Alipay+ and UnionPay International.
The bank's RM100 million senior notes matured.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between October and November.
There were boardroom and Nomination and Remuneration Committee changes, including a change in Encik Alan Hamzah Sendut's role.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR1,716,032,000, up 10.5% QoQ and 7.9% YoY; net income was MYR1,242,727,000, up 20.7% QoQ and 14.2% YoY; net margin was 72.4%, higher than 66.3% in the previous period.
